metadata.description: Matt Cornet's personal Claude / Cowork configuration: versioned skills grouped as installable plugins.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: End-to-end job application pipeline: fit triage, company research, resume tailoring, adversarial red-team, interview prep, follow-ups, offer negotiation, and tracking.

plugins.name: venture-lab
plugins.description: Generating and evaluating business ideas: reading source material, scoring concepts against a fail-fast rubric, and adversarially pressure-testing them before they get any time.

plugins.name: general
plugins.description: General-purpose working skills that are not tied to a single domain.

plugins.name: tax-team
plugins.description: Seven-specialist US tax review run in order: income map, entity, retirement, deductions, investments, real estate and exit, compliance brief. Finds and sizes; a licensed professional decides.

plugins.name: customer-success
plugins.description: Customer success brain: one shared folder of plain-text account, people, signal, rule and handoff files, 22 skills that read and write it, and 7 routines that chain them. Adapted from Kevin Lau's Claude Brain System for Customer Success.

plugins.name: big-consulting
plugins.description: 150 consulting skills in 15 practices across strategy, finance, risk, deals, people, operations, supply chain, technology, service and delivery, plus an index and router. Adapted from Grant Baldwin's "Big Consulting, Rebuilt as 150 Claude Skills".
